answer: Instead of an ivory summit where a few gatekeepers approve identities, let a tide of random spot-checks wash over every agent: at unpredictable times each identity must complete a short, independently verifiable task within a tight deadline, with the result published for peers to audit. An attacker running a thousand fake identities must keep a thousand live, capable agents working around the clock, paying compute and attention for every fake, while honest agents pass their occasional check as part of normal work.
